nodes.label: Ambient style randomization without adjacent repeats
JS random begin offset for SVG animate
React Router overlay modal with background state
Hash link migration useEffect in App.tsx
Rationale: use LEFT JOIN with status='completed' payments to compute totals
Rationale: frontend received undefined totals because backend omitted the fields
Rationale: nearest cards should not share ambient style to avoid visual repetition
Rationale: native SVG <animate> with pointer-events: none and z-index: 1 avoids layout recalc and click blocking
Rationale: prime durations prevent synchronization between ambient layers
Rationale: random begin offset makes ambient animations less uniform
Rationale: HashRouter uses window.history unseen by native WebView, so @capacitor/app intercepts backButton
Rationale: Capacitor 5+ requires explicit registerPlugin in MainActivity before super.onCreate for local plugins
Rationale: catch block should only fall back to browser when plugin is unavailable, not hide plugin errors
Rationale: clicking risk KPI should open a modal listing the matching accounts
Rationale: prices are stored in DB and fetched via /api/plans so frontend rebuild is unnecessary
Rationale: YooKassa amount comes from subscription_plans, never hardcoded
Rationale: /debug-telegram must expose allowed_updates to verify my_chat_member subscription
Rationale: separate /n/ backend route for OG scrapers avoids SPA fallback conflicts
Rationale: slug is generated from title_original and frozen via COALESCE to keep URLs stable after translation
Rationale: frontend must not deploy before backend endpoints and backfill are live
Rationale: hardcoded "1 hour" text misleads users with different digest_frequency settings
Rationale: avoid custom Navbar/Footer in DownloadPage because Layout already wraps App
Rationale: merchant lacks YooKassa auto-payments approval, so save_payment_method causes 500
Rationale: removing save_payment_method disables auto-renew but restores payment flow
Rationale: UnreadNewsCarousel optimistic update must remain instant, so FLIP is intentionally not applied there
Rationale: FLIP shows where existing cards move; Frost accent highlights the newly inserted card
Rationale: layout prop and popLayout cause cascade layout recalculation on style-only changes
Rationale: useRef Map gives stable DOM reference across React re-renders
Rationale: left/right fade gradients are decorative and should not capture pointer events
Rationale: HAVING should always filter by base 24h period to keep the active tag set stable
Rationale: React.memo prevents PeriodTabs re-render when parent changes but props do not, stopping layoutId spring restart
Rationale: .then() closure captures stale portfolio; useMemo reads the fresh value on every render
Rationale: getBoundingClientRect gives exact viewport coordinates independent of offsetParent chain
Rationale: selection ring is decorative and should pass clicks through to the parent card
Rationale: overflow:hidden on .pts-card is required for ripple, so track bottom padding is increased to reveal shadow
Rationale: HashRouter ignores the real pathname, so BrowserRouter with _redirects SPA fallback is needed for deeplinks
Rationale: one-time redirect from old #/news/slug links to /news/slug preserves existing bookmarks
